_meta.title: Baseline French tax-benefit parameters
_meta.legislation: State of the law on 2026-10-24 (latest available). Mixed effective dates are explicit on each parameter.
_meta.income_tax_note: Barème = loi de finances pour 2026 (loi n° 2026-103 du 19/02/2026) applied to revenus 2025 (impôt payé en 2026). No barème for revenus 2026 exists yet (PLF 2027 not enacted); it is used as the best available proxy for 'current IR'.
_meta.units: EUR amounts are EUR; *_monthly = EUR per month; *_annual = EUR per year; rates are fractions (0.1 = 10%).

status_legend.official: read on a government site (service-public, solidarites.gouv.fr, ...)
status_legend.official_republished: official figure republished by a public body or specialist press quoting the legal text
status_legend.oracle: only found in the OpenFisca-France parameter files, which cite the Légifrance text

_meta.generated_by: research/baseline/parameters.json is hand-curated; validated by scripts/openfisca_golden.py + a Python reference implementation (40 golden cases)
